column1: # ACMG SF v3.2: the 81 genes the American College of Medical Genetics and
# Genomics recommends reporting secondary findings in (Miller DT et al. ACMG SF
# v3.2 list for reporting of secondary findings in clinical exome and genome
# Gene spans (1-based, inclusive; all RefSeq transcripts merged) are from UCSC
# refGene for hg19 and hg38, as `wgsextract ref gene-map` downloads them.
# `wgsextract report` lists ClinVar pathogenic/likely-pathogenic calls inside
# these spans. The list is a technical filter, not a clinical test.
